description: Capabilities for the main Playback window. Least-privilege: only the permissions the app actually uses. The devtools inspector is still available in dev/debug builds via the WebView's native shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+I / right-click Inspect), so the JS-callable internal-toggle-devtools permission is intentionally NOT granted — it shipped in release builds and only widened the local surface (sec-004 / sec-001 F-4). The dialog grant is scoped to just dialog:allow-open: the app only opens the file picker, so dialog:default (which also enables message + save) is not granted, and the redundant dialog:allow-open it used to be paired with is gone (sec-006 / sec-001 F-7). There is deliberately NO clipboard grant at all (img-002): the photo viewer's Copy runs entirely in Rust, through the copy_image_to_clipboard command, so the WebView is never able to read or write the user's clipboard on its own — only that one command can, and only with a picture.
